title: DreameHome for Android (com.dreame.smartlife) before 2.6.4.0 contains a download of code without integrity check…
description: DreameHome for Android versions before 2.6.4.0 has a vulnerability in its code download process where downloaded React Native bundles are only verified using a client-stored MD5 checksum without authenticating the publisher. This allows attackers positioned on the network to replace the bundles and their checksums, enabling execution of arbitrary JavaScript code with the app's permissions.
